description: This file is a Perl script designed to generate a MIME type configuration for the Lighttpd web server by reading the system's mime.types file, applying custom rules for conflicts, and producing a structured mime-type assign configuration including comments and explanations.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension in the internal hash maps.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates an extension-to-MIME type mapping, resolving conflicts with custom rules and rules for precedence.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Prints out a formatted line for a MIME type assignment within the configuration, appending charset for text types when appropriate.
